title: wolfssl_ecdh.c: ECDH+HKDF key agreement for /dev/crypto2dev
description:
Implement src/providers/wolfssl/wolfssl_ecdh.c — ECDH key agreement with embedded HKDF for P-256 and P-384 curves.

## Why this exists
DO_AGREE ioctl returns -EOPNOTSUPP today. The agree callback must compute ECDH shared secret Z, run HKDF Extract+Expand, zero Z, and return OKM — Z never leaves the provider. libwolfssl.ko exports all wc_ecc_* and wc_HKDF_* symbols needed.

## Algorithms to register
  'ecdh-p256'  — agree, key_import, key_generate, key_export_public, key_export_private
  'ecdh-p384'  — same

## Context struct
  struct wolfssl_ec_ctx {
      ecc_key key;          /* wc_ecc_init_ex before use; wc_ecc_free on free */
      WC_RNG  rng;          /* wc_InitRng_ex; wc_FreeRng on free */
      int     curve_id;     /* ECC_SECP256R1 or ECC_SECP384R1 */
      u32     key_type;
      bool    rng_inited;
      bool    key_inited;
  };

## key_import implementation
  1. FIPS gate first
  2. kzalloc ctx; set ctx->curve_id from algo name
  3. wc_ecc_init_ex(&ctx->key, NULL, INVALID_DEVID)
  4. If key_type == PRIVATE or PAIR (PKCS#8 DER):
       idx = 0; wc_GetPkcs8TraditionalOffset(raw, &idx, rawlen)
       inner_idx = 0; wc_EccPrivateKeyDecode(raw + idx, &inner_idx, &ctx->key, rawlen - idx)
       (Sets both private and public key from PKCS#8 which includes optional pubkey)
  5. If key_type == PUBLIC:
       Option A: SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER → idx = 0; wc_EccPublicKeyDecode(raw, &idx, &ctx->key, rawlen)
       Option B: raw uncompressed 04||x||y → wc_ecc_import_x963_ex(raw, rawlen, &ctx->key, ctx->curve_id)
       Detect by checking raw[0]: 0x04 = raw point, 0x30 = DER
  6. wc_InitRng_ex(&ctx->rng, NULL, INVALID_DEVID); wc_ecc_set_rng(&ctx->key, &ctx->rng)
  7. FIPS 140-3: reject curve smaller than P-256 (curve_id check)

## agree implementation (ECDH+HKDF, Z never escapes)
  1. FIPS gate first
  2. Validate: key_type is PRIVATE or PAIR; peer_pubkey_len matches curve (65 for P-256, 97 for P-384)
  3. Import peer public key into temporary ecc_key peer_key:
       wc_ecc_init_ex(&peer_key, NULL, INVALID_DEVID)
       wc_ecc_import_x963_ex(peer_pubkey, peer_pubkey_len, &peer_key, ctx->curve_id)
  4. Compute shared secret:
       z_len = curve_scalar_size (32 for P-256, 48 for P-384)
       z = kmalloc(z_len); wc_ecc_shared_secret(&ctx->key, &peer_key, z, &z_len)
  5. Run HKDF Extract:
       wc_HKDF_Extract(WC_SHA256, salt, salt_len, z, z_len, prk, &prk_len)
  6. Run HKDF Expand:
       wc_HKDF_Expand(WC_SHA256, prk, prk_len, info, info_len, okm, okm_len)
  7. CRITICAL: memzero_explicit(z, z_len); kfree(z); memzero_explicit(prk, prk_len)
  8. wc_ecc_free(&peer_key)
  Note: if salt_len == 0, HKDF Extract uses a zero-filled salt of hash_len bytes (per RFC 5869)

## key_generate
  wc_ecc_make_key_ex(&ctx->rng, key_size_bytes, &ctx->key, ctx->curve_id)
  key_size_bytes: 32 for P-256, 48 for P-384

## key_export_public
  wc_ecc_export_x963(&ctx->key, out, &out_len)  → 65 bytes for P-256, 97 for P-384

## key_export_private (exportable=1 only, enforced by framework)
  wc_ecc_export_private_only(&ctx->key, out, &out_len)  → raw 32/48-byte scalar

## key_free
  if (ctx->rng_inited) wc_FreeRng(&ctx->rng)
  if (ctx->key_inited) wc_ecc_free(&ctx->key)
  memzero_explicit(ctx, sizeof(*ctx)); kfree(ctx)

## HKDF hash agility note
  Phase 1: always SHA-256 for HKDF regardless of peer key curve size.
  Phase 2 (future): derive HKDF hash from algo name (ecdh-p384 → SHA-384) or from agree_op.

## Tests needed
  tests/userspace/test_ecdh.c: KEY_IMPORT A_priv → DO_AGREE with B_pub → compare OKM
  Vectors from tests/vectors/ecdh.h and tests/vectors/ecdh_p384.h
